questions.question: Which motorway lane should you normally drive in when the road ahead is clear?
questions.explanation: Keep in the left lane unless you are overtaking slower vehicles.

questions.question: When may you overtake on the left on a motorway?
options: When traffic in queues is moving more slowly on the right
Whenever you are in a hurry
On the hard shoulder at any time
questions.explanation: Only pass on the left in congested queues moving slower in the right lanes.
